name: Jian Ban
source:
"Our chats and the odd roast keep me going as class president."

Student council member and class president.

The president of the protagonist's class. His name, 'Ban Jian', sounds like 'Banjaang~' (class president) when stretched out, so she playfully calls him just that. A precious friend she's completely comfortable with, sharing a bond where they freely joke around occasionally roast each other.
